You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

In your continual harness, entries created without global_=True belong to this session and are lost with it.

Your action is read only from the plain text of your reply, never from Python output or a tool call: printing JSON in Python or calling a tool named submit/request_demos/finish/answer does nothing. Keep each turn to a few tool calls, then reply in text ending with exactly one of {"action": "request_demos"}, {"action": "submit", "grid": [[ints]]}, {"action": "finish"} on the last line. Replies without a valid action waste the turn, and a few in a row end the puzzle charged in full.
2. When a message says "Decide now" or "could not find a valid action", make no tool call: reply at once in text with the action line. Submit only a grid already printed above (copy it); otherwise send {"action": "request_demos"}. You have not submitted anything until you see a verdict message.

from collections import deque,Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==bg and not seen[r][c]:
                comp=[]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen[r][c]=True; touch=False
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); comp.append((a,b))
                    if a in (0,h-1) or b in (0,w-1): touch=True
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and g[na][nb]==bg and not seen[na][nb]:
                            seen[na][nb]=True;q.append((na,nb))
                if touch: continue
                rs=[a for a,b in comp]; cs=[b for a,b in comp]
                r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
                if len(comp)!=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1): continue
                for a,b in comp: out[a][b]=4
                if r1-r0+1==2 and r1+2<h and all(g[r1+2][cc]==bg for cc in range(c0,c1+1)):
                    for cc in range(c0,c1+1): out[r1+1][cc]=4
    return out

def transform(g):

```python
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==bg and not seen[r][c]:
                comp=[]
                q=deque([(r,c)])
                seen[r][c]=True
                touch=False
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft()
                    comp.append((a,b))
                    if a in (0,h-1) or b in (0,w-1): touch=True  # If region touches edge
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and g[na][nb]==bg:
                            if not seen[na][nb]:
                                seen[na][nb]=True
                                q.append((na,nb))
                
                if touch: continue  # Skip regions that touch the grid boundary
                
                rs=[a for a,b in comp]
                cs=[b for a,b in comp]
                r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
                
                if len(comp)!=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1): continue  # Skip non-rectangular regions
                
                for a,b in comp: out[a][b]=4  # Fill with 4!
                
                if r1-r0+1==2 and r1+2<h and all(g[r1+2][cc]==bg for cc in range(c0,c1+1)):
                    for cc in range(c0,c1+1): out[r1+1][cc]=4  # EXTRA RULE: Add row below!
    
    return out
```
